Captured output: `audit_recovery_subcase4_output.txt`.

**Negative validation.**  `diagnostic_fix15/` makes the branch reachable with
`preAcceptCount > 0 && preAcceptCount >= r.F/2`.  The focused test and cluster
controls pass, but the 500-seed campaign becomes 321 pass / **85 SKIP** / 94
NOOP / 0 divergence: in 85 seeds no replica retains the proposed value at the
snapshot, so the proposal disappears (`diagnostic_fix15_campaign500_output.txt`).
That is a liveness regression, not a validated fix.  The correct sub-case 4
guard (threshold, `leaderResponded` handling, and interaction with
TryPreAccept) needs the corrected TLA/upstream reference.

Adding the validated F12/F17 conflict fixes in `diagnostic_fix16/` does not
rescue it: the same 500-seed result is 321 pass / 85 SKIP / 94 NOOP / 0
divergence (`diagnostic_fix16_campaign500_output.txt`), so the loss comes from
the sub-case-4 guard/threshold itself, not from the TryPreAccept conflict-table
bugs alone.  The focused F12/F17 and F27 tests do pass in that copy
(`diagnostic_fix16_subcase_output.txt`).

**Impact.**  The shipped recovery never exercises the documented TryPreAccept
sub-case, so its behavior is untested.  The obvious repair is unsafe without
the specification; this is a Medium unresolved recovery-path defect.

## Conclusion

The normal all-alive path and ordinary message reordering work in the
in-process cluster controls.  The failures are concentrated in crash
recovery and boundary handling:

item.text:
I refined the F27 negative result and corrected its interpretation.

The 85 “SKIP” seeds in the naive sub-case 4 experiment do not lose the client command. Instead, recovery finishes with the value still **PREACCEPTED** and no COMMITTED PUT or NOOP. Seed 3 ends with all five replicas `PREACCEPTED` on the proposed value ([output](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/diagnostic_fix15_skip_debug_output.txt)).

I also ruled out the obvious confounders: adding the validated F12/F17 TryPreAccept conflict fixes (`diagnostic_fix16/`) and then the F6 TryPreAccept `vbal` fix (`diagnostic_fix17/`) leaves the same **321 pass / 85 stalled / 94 NOOP / 0 divergence** result ([F17 output](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/diagnostic_fix17_campaign500_output.txt)). The inferred `f/2` guard/flow is therefore the unresolved part; it remains a negative diagnostic, not a recommended fix.

The audit remains at **27 findings**, **42 failing finding tests**, and **5 passing controls**; the captured source is unchanged and builds cleanly. The corrected F27 interpretation and the F16/F17 controls are recorded in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/report.md), [validation_matrix.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/validation_matrix.md), [remediation.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/remediation.md), and [handoff_check.txt](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/handoff_check.txt).
